entries.description: Review demand across comparable operating periods and room conditions. Investigate sustained changes before adjusting setpoints or equipment schedules.

entries.title: Fuel inventory
entries.description: Monitor tank levels remotely and review unusual level changes. Plan refilling and investigate discrepancies with a timestamped operating history.

entries.title: Fuel consumption
entries.description: Connect fuel flow to the equipment and time period using it. Compare consumption patterns across runs to support operational and cost reviews.

entries.title: Conveyor material weight
entries.description: Track material moving through conveyors to support consistent feed rates. Review changes alongside production conditions and material records.

entries.title: Bag weight checks
entries.description: Surface underweight or overweight exceptions during packing. Give quality teams records to review against the applicable product requirements.

entries.title: Silo availability
entries.description: Follow material levels across silos and set site-specific high and low thresholds. Use the information to coordinate replenishment and production planning.

entries.title: Equipment condition
entries.description: Review vibration, temperature and run-time trends from connected equipment. Prioritise inspections around changes that merit investigation.

entries.title: Electrical demand
entries.description: Understand loads at a circuit, machine or production-area level. Compare demand with shift activity and identify persistent idle loads.

entries.title: Dust and filtration
entries.description: Monitor relevant dust and bag-filter operating signals. Help maintenance teams review changes alongside local environmental and safety procedures.

entries.title: Backup power readiness
entries.description: Track generator status, fuel availability and operating hours. Keep backup-power checks visible to the people responsible for continuity.

entries.title: Workplace conditions
entries.description: Bring environmental readings into the site view. Use location-based alerts to support the team’s established operating procedures.

entries.title: Water in the process
entries.description: Measure water consumption across relevant process areas. Review trends and unexpected flow to guide inspections and resource planning.

entries.title: Can existing meters be included?
entries.description: Review the available interfaces, protocols and access conditions with our team. The integration plan depends on the meters and systems installed at your site.

entries.title: Can we compare different sites?
entries.description: A common measurement structure helps teams compare sites or areas. Keep differences in opening hours, loads and operating conditions in view when interpreting results.

entries.title: Will monitoring guarantee a saving?
entries.description: Monitoring provides the detail needed to investigate and verify changes. Savings depend on the site, the opportunities identified and the actions implemented.

entries.title: Where should we start?
entries.description: Choose a meaningful boundary with a clear owner—such as a plant room, production area or building—and agree the first questions the data needs to answer.
